clause: §9.5 ({bates} replaced first, a label containing {bates} must not double-expand)
claim: No Bates test would catch the {bates} replacement moving after {label}. Mutant M1 (stampTextFor in build/engine.js replaces {bates} after {label}) keeps bates (a) to (f) green, 6/6.
reproduction: .quad/scratch/bates/review-engine/mut/M1 plus mutants.out: 6/6 green. probe.mjs with BUILD=mut/M1: labels-set prefix 'L{bates}-', then header '[{label}] {bates}' with start 9, pad 2 on p1. M1 gives '[L09-2] 09'; the real build gives '[L{bates}-2] 09'.
fix: In bates (e) (or (b)), add labels-set {from:0, style:'D', prefix:'L{bates}-'}, stamp '[{label}] {bates}' on [1], then assert.match(pageText(doc,1), /\[L\{bates\}-2\] 09/).

claim: No test catches the watermark width going back to template.length. Mutant M4 stays green, yet it moves a 15-digit {bates} watermark about 96 pt off the page centre, and a triple {bates} watermark loses 8 digits off the page.
reproduction: mutants.out M4: 6/6 green. probe.mjs, watermark '{bates}' pad 15 start 1 on nav p0: the real build's stext centre is (323.5, 384.5); M4's is (391.5, 316.5). The page centre is (306, 396).
fix: In bates (e), stamp '{bates}{bates}{bates}' with pad 15 on p0 and assert the stext line centre is within 30 pt of (306, 396). The real build gives (306, 404).

claim: The real right-edge error is 0.00 pt on all four rotations and on nav. The test reads −1 pt only because asJSON() floors bbox values to integers. With the 10 pt tolerance, mutant M3 (the 0.556 estimate, +4.42 pt) stays green, so the advanceGlyph measurement is not pinned. The contract keeps the 10 pt tolerance on purpose.
reproduction: edge.mjs: Tm 510.42, last glyph quad x1 = 576.0; asJSON(100) bbox gives 51042 + 6557. mutants.out M3: 6/6 green.
fix: Optional: read the line bbox from asJSON(100)/100 and tighten the check to 1 pt. Otherwise leave it as the contract says.

claim: Test (c) leaves out pad 1.5, pad '6', start NaN or null, and align 'RIGHT' or null. All of them refuse correctly in the probes, but no test pins them.
reproduction: refuse.mjs: 34/34 OK, on a fresh document and after one edit.
fix: Add those rows to the (c) table.

claim: saveStampDialog never clears #error. After a human's Bates refusal, a later successful Apply leaves the old message in STATE.error and in the red bar. The drive path never shows this because driveStamp calls clearError() first.
reproduction: Run node .quad/shared/p6/checks/review-bates-renderer-mouse.mjs under the lock. On nav: header 'X-{bates}' with start 'abc' is refused (correct). Then text 'Page {page} of {pages}' is applied: revision goes 1->2, but STATE.error is still 'Bates start must be a whole number and digits 1–15'. Screenshot review-out/review-bates-c-nav-fitpage.png shows the stale bar.
fix: Add clearError(); as the first statement of saveStampDialog.

claim: A GUI Bates refusal returns before addStamp and never calls decorateLast. STATE decorate.last keeps showing the previous {ok:true,bates:{from:500,to:502}} while the dialog shows a refusal. The drive path records ok:false.
reproduction: Same probe, gate 'abc: decorate.last after GUI refusal': last is still the earlier footer success.
fix: Before 'return false', call decorateLast({ action: "stamp", kind, ok: false }). Move the kind computation above the check or recompute it.

claim: A one-page Bates stamp announces a degenerate range: 'Added header to 1 page (Bates 000503–000503)'.
reproduction: Probe: open hello.pdf, header 'DOC {bates}', then read #page-status.

claim: The Apply gate waits for s.revision === 1, but applyEdit (renderer.ts:5350-5351) sets revision synchronously before its awaits, and addStamp only calls decorateLast and sets batesNext after await applyEdit (renderer.ts:7667-7683). A poll that lands in that window sees decorate still absent after the open (§9.13), and line 191 deq(undefined, true) exits 1: the GUI proof can fail when nothing is wrong.
reproduction: Read renderer.ts:5350-5366 (revision set before the refreshNotes/Fields/Outline/Links/ContentTargets awaits) and renderer.ts:7663-7690 (decorateLast after await applyEdit). A STATE read between those points returns revision 1 with no decorate key.
fix: Wait on s.decorate?.bates?.next === 503 (or s.decorate?.last?.ok === true) instead of revision === 1, then assert revision 1.

claim: The pad carry-over check is vacuous. S2 sends batesPad 6, which is the default, so the pad 6 expects on S5 and S9 still pass if batesPad = pad (renderer.ts:7675) is deleted. No drive step sends batesPad as a numeric string (§2.3). No drive step sends a bad align ('Align must be left or right', renderer.ts:1194), even though design-agent-drive.md:72 advertises that refusal.
reproduction: Delete renderer.ts:7675 in thought: the pad stays at its default of 6 and every bates.jsonl expect (pad 6) and every p6-bates assertion still passes. grep for 'align' in tests/drive/*.jsonl finds no non-left/right value.
fix: bates.jsonl must stay template-verbatim (§9.18), so add a NEW drive, e.g. tests/drive/bates-pad.jsonl, run by p6-bates: open nav; footer ACME-{bates} batesStart 1 batesPad "4" → decorate.bates {next:4,pad:4}; header {bates} with no start or pad → last.bates {from:4,to:6}, pad 4; header-footer align "centre" → error 'Align must be left or right', revision unchanged.

claim: The red-before run covers only p2-decorate (a)-(f) and two p2-shell tests. The new hint pin (p2-shell:95) never goes red on its own because the REQUIRED_IDS assert fails first in the same test. p6-bates and bates.jsonl have no red run.
reproduction: grep '^not ok' bates-red-before.log: 8 entries, no p6-bates, and test 7 fails on REQUIRED_IDS before it reaches line 95.
fix: Note the gap in bates-build.md, or run p6-bates against the pre-bates build and log the result.

claim: bates-b's right edge is checked against its own computed target, but the test never pins that target to 576. bates-a pins it at line 108.
reproduction: Read p6-bates.test.mjs:114-121: there is no assert.equal(line.target, 576) for b.
